scenarios.title: A Cáceres pasture claim needs checking
scenarios.summary: A example Cáceres sheep holding has seven example fields, D01–D07, whose individual outline areas sum to 27.96 ha, not a surveyed or overlap-free holding total. Four have no additional seeded concern; the three demo concerns are D04's pasture claim, D05's overlap with another field in this same example holding, and D07's missing crop. D04 keeps its full 6.70 ha physical outline: the supplied 45% coefficient gives a rounded 3.02 ha claimable figure and 3.68 ha difference, not a contiguous excluded subpolygon, verified eligibility or payment decision.
scenarios.farmer_goal: Check the seven-field map, resolve D05's own-field overlap and D07's missing crop, and understand why D04's original 6.70 ha claim differs from the supplied 3.02 ha figure.
scenarios.adviser_goal: Review the original statement, the supplied pasture coefficient and evidence for any SIGPAC allegation; distinguish physical area, supplied claimable area and the authority's decision.
expected_actions: Open the seven-field map. D01, D02, D03 and D06 have no additional seeded concern, not an official all-clear. D05 intentionally overlaps D06, another field in this same example holding; inspect both outlines before choosing the intended boundary. No neighbour's private or official data is supplied.
D07 has no crop recorded. Enter the actual crop only after checking its source; do not guess it from a map or copy a neighbouring field.
Open the original statement and supplied reference for D04, the scrub-pasture field. All four prefilled facts are bound to D04 and remain unconfirmed until separately reviewed.

Compare D04's 6.70 ha claimed figure with the supplied 3.02 ha maximum and 45% coefficient. The arithmetic is 6.70 × 45% = 3.015 ha, displayed as 3.02 ha; 6.70 − 3.02 = 3.68 ha is a rounded difference, not a mapped excluded area or a penalty.
Option A: review a proposed future D04 claim of 3.02 ha separately from the original statement. The original claimed 6.70 ha remains intact; checking a proposal does not mean it has been filed.

Option B: the example farmer says scrub was cleared last winter. Prepare a SIGPAC allegation only after checking dated geotagged photos, a lease or other actual land-use evidence and the current official route. No photos, lease or authority decision are seeded.
Keep D04's physical 6.70 ha outline unchanged. A 45% coefficient is not a command to shrink it, nor proof of a contiguous 55% exclusion.
Check any protected-area designation and applicable conditions separately. No real Natura 2000 intersection or automatic ineligibility is established.
National amendment deadlines, AMS regime, control stage and official acceptance remain unknown. Review every prefilled answer and selected source before any manual handoff.

Scenario: example Cáceres sheep holding, campaign 2026

Supplied category: scrub pasture (PR)
Physical parcel area recorded in this example: 6.70 ha

No actual filing date, submission receipt, payment, official parcel match or authority acceptance is established. This is a literal demo source for separate human review, not evidence that a real farmer made a claim.

Campaign: 2026
Field: D04, one of seven example private fields in the example holding
Example SIGPAC code: 10:999:0:0:12:34:1 — example
Supplied category: scrub pasture (PR)
Physical parcel area: 6.70 ha
Supplied pasture coefficient: 45%
Supplied maximum claimable area: 3.02 ha, rounded from 6.70 × 0.45 = 3.015 ha
Rounded physical-minus-supplied-claimable difference: 3.68 ha. This is not a payment refusal, penalty or geographically identified exclusion.

Protected-area designation and applicable restrictions remain unknown; no real Natura 2000 intersection or automatic ineligibility is established. National amendment deadlines, monitoring regime, control stage and actual filing route remain unverified.
The separate map concerns are D05's intentional overlap with own-field D06 and D07's blank crop. No neighbour's data or further official finding is supplied.
